description:
Excellent opportunity for investors to purchase this reasonably priced home. Having an ideal location within easy access to Stockton High Street and also Norton High Street, this property also benefits from private enclosed garden and pleasant outlook to the front. The property is also within close proximity to local schools and viewing is recommended. Benefitting from gas central heating, a recently fitted roof and recently fitted double glazing, the property is accessed via enclosed front garden with gate. The entry door opens into a hallway which has door to the rear garden and also gives access to the downstairs accommodation. There is a spacious living room with window to the front and patio doors to the rear opening into the garden, a good sized kitchen with pantry cupboard and downstairs w/c. To the first floor there is a landing area, three bedrooms and bathroom. Two of the bedrooms are doubles, the third is a good sized single and the bathroom is fitted with a three piece suite. Externally to the front there is a garden enclosed by wall which is gravelled with pathway. To the rear is a further enclosed garden which again is laid to lawn with patio area.

ENTRANCE HALLWAY Entered via UPVC door with staircase to first floor and further door to the rear garden.

DOWNSTAIRS W/C With toilet and sink.

LIVING ROOM Good sized reception room with window to the front and patio doors to the rear opening into the garden.

KITCHEN With fitted units, worktop, tiled splashback, space for appliances, integrated extractor, sink unit, breakfast bar, window to front aspect and pantry style cupboard.

FIRST FLOOR LANDING Access to upstairs accommodation.

BEDROOM ONE Double room with window to front.

BEDROOM TWO Double room with window to front.

BEDROOM THREE Single room with window to rear.

BATHROOM Mainly tiled with window to rear and fitted with suite comprising: bath with overhead shower, toilet and sink.

EXTERNALLY Externally to the front there is a garden enclosed by wall which is gravelled with pathway. To the rear is a further enclosed garden which again is laid to lawn with patio area.

GENERAL INFORMATION Council Tax - Band A Please note: All measurements including floorplans are approximate only. Where mentioned regarding a recently fitted roof and recently fitted double glazing, the full documents regarding installation dates and works carried out would need to be obtained fully from the vendors.
